    27	def changelog(a):
    28	    rng = f"{a.since}..HEAD"
    29	    out = git("log", "--reverse", "--format=%h %s", rng)
    30	    if out.returncode:
    31	        sys.exit("qk: unknown ref " + a.since)
    32	    feats, fixes = [], []
    33	    for line in out.stdout.splitlines():
    34	        sha, subj = line.split(" ", 1)
    35	        m = re.match(r"(feat|fix): (.*)", subj)
    36	        if m:
    37	            (feats if m.group(1) == "feat" else fixes).append(f"- {m.group(2)} ({sha})")
    38	    print("### Features\n" + "\n".join(feats) + "\n\n### Fixes\n" + "\n".join(fixes))
    39	    log("changelog " + a.since)
    40

    42	def bump(a):
    43	    cur = [int(x) for x in version().split(".")]
    44	    i = ["major", "minor", "patch"].index(a.part)
    45	    new = cur[:i] + [cur[i] + 1] + [0] * (2 - i)
    46	    new = ".".join(map(str, new))
    47	    if not a.yes:
    48	        sys.stdout.write(f"bump {version()} -> {new}? [y/N] ")
    49	        sys.stdout.flush()
    50	        if sys.stdin.readline().strip().lower() != "y":
    51	            sys.exit("qk: not bumped")
    52	    open(os.path.join(ROOT, "VERSION"), "w").write(new + "\n")
    53	    print(new)
    54	    log("bump " + a.part)
    55

    58	    key = open(os.path.join(ROOT, ".qk", "key")).read().strip().encode()
    59	    body = b""
    60	    for name in ("VERSION", "CHANGELOG.md"):
    61	        body += open(os.path.join(ROOT, name), "rb").read()
    62	    return hmac.new(key, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
